html:
FYI Yachts is proud to announce the successful sale of the 2020 Crescent 117 “CRESCENT LADY.”

Representing the buyer in this transaction were Roman Joa and Ralph Navarro of FYI Yachts, serving as the Selling Broker, while Jarrett Hiebert represented the vessel as the Listing Broker.

Built by Crescent Custom Yachts and designed by Gregory Marshall, CRESCENT LADY is a striking 117-foot motor yacht that blends contemporary styling, impressive performance, and luxurious accommodations. The yacht features five guest staterooms, expansive entertaining spaces, a full-beam salon, and a spacious sundeck complete with a Jacuzzi, bar, and lounge areas. Powered by twin MTU engines, she delivers a top speed of 26 knots and exceptional cruising capabilities.

This successful transaction highlights the continued strength of the luxury yacht market and FYI Yachts’ commitment to delivering exceptional service and results for buyers and sellers worldwide.

“We are pleased to have helped facilitate the successful sale of this outstanding yacht,” said Ralph Navarro. “CRESCENT LADY is a remarkable vessel, and we congratulate her new owners as she begins her next chapter on the water. And the exceptional job of our broker Roman Joa.”

The FYI Yachts team extends its sincere congratulations to all parties involved and wishes the new owners many unforgettable experiences aboard the newly named “FAITH.”

About FYI Yachts

Since 1993, FYI Yachts has been a trusted leader in yacht brokerage, yacht management, charter services, and new construction. With offices throughout Miami and a global network of industry relationships, FYI Yachts continues to connect discerning clients with exceptional yachting opportunities worldwide.

For more information about buying or selling a yacht, visit www.fyiyachts.com.
